name: dropdown-menu
title: Dropdown menu
description: A menu of actions, checkboxes, and radio items that a button opens.

files.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import "../core/vitehub.css";
import "./dropdown-menu.css";
import { Menu } from "@ui-sdk/vue/menu";
import type { DropdownMenuEmits, DropdownMenuProps, DropdownMenuSlots } from "./types.ts";

const open = defineModel<boolean | undefined>("open", { default: undefined });
const { defaultOpen = false } = defineProps<DropdownMenuProps>();
defineEmits<DropdownMenuEmits>();
defineSlots<DropdownMenuSlots>();
</script>

<template>
  <Menu v-model:open="open" :default-open="defaultOpen || undefined"><slot /></Menu>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { MenuSeparator } from "@ui-sdk/vue/menu";
</script>

<template>
  <MenuSeparator>
    <template #render="{ props: part }">
      <div v-bind="part" data-slot="dropdown-menu-separator" />
    </template>
  </MenuSeparator>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { MenuSub } from "@ui-sdk/vue/menu";
import type { DropdownMenuSubEmits, DropdownMenuSubProps, DropdownMenuSubSlots } from "./types.ts";

const open = defineModel<boolean | undefined>("open", { default: undefined });
const { defaultOpen = false } = defineProps<DropdownMenuSubProps>();
defineEmits<DropdownMenuSubEmits>();
defineSlots<DropdownMenuSubSlots>();
</script>

<template>
  <MenuSub v-model:open="open" :default-open="defaultOpen || undefined"><slot /></MenuSub>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { MenuTrigger } from "@ui-sdk/vue/menu";
import type { DropdownMenuTriggerSlots } from "./types.ts";

defineSlots<DropdownMenuTriggerSlots>();
</script>

<template>
  <MenuTrigger>
    <!-- The ui-sdk part writes its own data-slot. The render slot keeps the item's name on the element. -->
    <template #render="{ props: part, children }">
      <button v-bind="part" data-slot="dropdown-menu-trigger"><component :is="children" /></button>
    </template>
    <slot />
  </MenuTrigger>
</template>
